Transforms the network shape to a flow map.

**Toolbox folder:** Network<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Network, Flowdirections<br>
**Authors:** Silvia Franceschi, Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Netshape2Flow`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inNet` | vector file |  |  | The network features. |
| `inGrid` | raster file |  |  | A raster whose grid, extent and resolution, is used for the output maps, for example the elevation model. |
| `fActive` | String |  |  | The field of the attributes table of the network flagging the feature as active. |
| `fId` | String |  |  | The field of the attributes table of the network defining the id of the feature. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outFlownet` | output file |  | The output flow map on the network pixels. |
| `outNet` | output file |  | The output network map. |
| `outProblems` | output file |  | The problems features points. |
